New Album

Where Tender Hearts Surrender

New 60s Motown soul ballad album · 12-track album

Lovewave Harmony Music presents Where Tender Hearts Surrender — a tender collection of 12 original 60s Motown soul ballads about soft surrender, quiet devotion and love that chooses to stay. Each song captures the moment defenses fall: a lingering gaze, a whispered yes, a heart that stops fighting and yields beautifully. Warm vintage Detroit soul with sweeping strings, gentle organ, walking bass and soulful male lead — perfect for slow jams playlists, vintage soul nights and late-night slow dances.

  • Sweeping strings
  • Gentle organ
  • Walking bass

Our Story

About

Lovewave Harmony Music creates original Soul-Motown ballads about destiny, devotion, and unfinished love. With warm Rhodes piano, cinematic strings, and a slow Motown pulse, each song is made for couples, late-night listeners, and old-school R&B hearts. Start with When Beauty Stole My Heart — our most-loved song.

Hi, we're Lovewave Harmony Music.

We write and produce original soft, heartfelt love songs inspired by 70s Soul, Motown, and old-school R&B slow jams.

No covers. No noise. Just honest songs about the moments love leaves behind — Where Our Dreams Become One, Something In You Feels Like Home, When Beauty Stole My Heart.

Every track is an original composition, produced with modern tools including AI-assisted arrangement, then human-curated for emotion, story, and soul.

Press play. Stay for the quiet part. That's where the love lives.

Privacy Policy

Lovewave Harmony Music · Last Updated: September 6, 2026

1. Who We Are

Lovewave Harmony Music ("we," "us," "our") is an independent original soul music project. This website shares our music, videos, and updates.

Data Controller: Lovewave Harmony Music
Contact: contact@lovewaveharmonymusic.com
Location: Stockholm, Sweden

If you have privacy questions, email us at the address above.

2. What Data We Collect

We collect only what we need to run this site:

a) Information you give us directly:

  • Email address when you sign up for our newsletter / updates
  • Name if you choose to provide it
  • Messages you send via contact forms or email

b) Information collected automatically:

  • Basic analytics data via Google Analytics: pages visited, time on page, device type, browser type, approximate location (city/country level), and how you found us
  • Cookie preferences

We do not collect payment details, as we do not sell directly on this site. We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data.

3. How We Use Your Data and Lawful Basis Under GDPR

  • To send newsletter updates and new music alerts — Legal basis: Consent. You can unsubscribe anytime via the link in every email.
  • To understand site traffic and improve content via Google Analytics, Spotify for Artists, and YouTube analytics — Legal basis: Legitimate interest in improving our site. IP addresses are anonymized where possible.
  • To respond to messages and permission requests — Legal basis: Legitimate interest.
  • To keep the site secure and prevent abuse — Legal basis: Legitimate interest.

We will never sell your email or personal data.

4. Email Signup

If you join our email list, we store your email to send you new releases, videos, and news. Provider: Mailchimp. Your data is stored by that provider on our behalf. Unsubscribe anytime and we will delete you from the marketing list promptly.

5. Third-Party Services and Embeds

This site embeds content from third parties that may collect their own data under their own policies:

  • YouTube embeds for music videos — YouTube / Google may set cookies and track views
  • Spotify embeds / links — Spotify may track listening interaction
  • Google Analytics — measures site traffic

We do not control those third parties. Please review their privacy policies before interacting.

6. Cookies

We use:

  • Strictly necessary cookies to make the site work
  • Analytics cookies to understand visits
  • Third-party cookies from YouTube / Spotify when you play embedded content

You can block cookies in your browser settings. Parts of embeds may not work if you do.

7. Data Sharing

We share data only with:

  • Email service provider to send newsletters
  • Analytics providers to measure traffic
  • Authorities if required by law

We do not share with advertisers or data brokers.

8. Data Retention

  • Newsletter emails: kept until you unsubscribe, then deleted from marketing list within 30 days
  • Contact messages: kept up to 12 months
  • Analytics data: kept up to 26 months, then auto-deleted / aggregated

9. Your Rights Under GDPR

If you are in the EU/EEA, you have the right to: access, correct, delete, restrict, object to processing, data portability, and withdraw consent at any time.

To exercise any right, email: contact@lovewaveharmonymusic.com. We respond within 30 days.

You also have the right to complain to your local Data Protection Authority. We hope you contact us first so we can help.

10. Security

We use SSL, limited access, and reputable providers to protect your data. No system is 100% secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect it.

11. Children

This site is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child provided data, contact us and we will delete it.

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy when we add features. The latest version will always be on this page with the updated date.
